name: Mated to the Tyrant Alpha:Our Blood Calls
original_name: Mated to the Tyrant Alpha:Our Blood Calls
overview: The opening masterpiece of the Moon God Trilogy—Klara, a forsaken mixed-blood orphan, is publicly rejected by an Alpha and branded with a mark of shame. After awakening the bloodline of the Moon God, she transforms into a Silver Moon Warwolf, rises from the ruins, rallies the outcasts, is crowned queen, and seals away the evil god. All the humiliation and betrayal of her past vanish the moment she gains immortality. But this is only the beginning of the Moon God’s legend—the shadows are not yet extinguished. A thousand years later, Isabella, the last survivor of the Moon Wolf Clan, will embark on a destiny entangled with Lycan King Blake in the second installment. And in the even more distant future, the third generation’s bloodline will bring the trilogy to its final chapter in the war of the end times.
